job.title: [Post] We're Hiring | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer Divvaa Techh is looking for an experi…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: Divvaa Techh's focus on growing its enterprise technology capabilities is an exciting environment for an experienced developer. With over 5 years of hands-on backend expertise building and extending SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical delivery across Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & Headless Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Enterprise Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Cloud & Production Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), managing production troubleshooting and performance tuning.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit requiring no sponsorship, I am serving a notice period ending on 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce expertise adds immediate value to Divvaa Techh.

tailoring.why_company: Divvaa Techh's expansion in enterprise e-commerce solutions presents an ideal match for my deep technical background in SAP Commerce Cloud. Having architected and scaled complex Hybris platforms for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, and robust data integrations to support your growing engineering team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development experience, Java/Spring backend depth, and enterprise integration expertise to Divvaa Techh.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Nikita, Divvaa Techh's focus on scaling SAP Commerce solutions caught my attention. With 5+ years building enterprise Hybris platforms (Java, Spring, OCC APIs) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'd love to connect. I have a valid German work permit and am available from Dec 16, 2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position at Divvaa Techh. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211).

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
